# Copilot instructions — Omni Forge
Follow `START_HERE.md` and `AGENTS.md`. Read `skills/omni-forge/SKILL.md` first (director workflow, Ultra Level 1000 by
default), then the skills the task needs. Build from `site/` and edit `site/config.js` first. Verify with
`python3 scripts/check.py site`. Ship with the workflows in `.github/workflows`. Never commit secrets.
